name: @coding-adventures/heap
description: Min-heap and max-heap backed by a flat array with O(log n) push/pop, O(1) peek, and pure helper utilities

scripts.test: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/tests/heap.test.js dist-test/tests/bounded-heap.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude=dist-test/tests/** --test-coverage-lines=95 --test-coverage-branches=95 --test dist-test/tests/heap.test.js dist-test/tests/bounded-heap.test.js

author: Adhithya Rajasekaran
